question: Which of the following schemes launched by the State Bank of India in January 2025 enables customers to accumulate ₹1 lakh or above in their accounts by depositing small savings every month?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Har Ghar Lakhpati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **State Bank of India (SBI)** officially launched the **Har Ghar Lakhpati** scheme in **January 2025** to promote a culture of disciplined savings among the Indian masses.
 
• The primary objective of this scheme is to enable individual customers to accumulate a corpus of **₹1 lakh or above** by contributing **small monthly installments** over a specified period.
 
• This initiative targets **retail customers** and **low-to-middle-income groups**, encouraging them to achieve significant financial milestones through manageable micro-savings. ***Hence, Har Ghar Lakhpati is the correct scheme described in the question.***
 
• Under this scheme, the **interest rates** provided are competitive and designed to help the savings grow faster than a traditional savings account, utilizing the power of **compounding**.
